description: Returns a step-by-step recipe as text: `story-episode` (an AI Video Story episode, end to end), `starter-video`, `starter-image`, `starter-audio` (a first generation), `fake-text` and `image-story` (write the script), `niche-run` (a niche from `list_niches`), `talking-avatar` (a picture speaks a script), `motion-control` (a picture copies a clip's motion). Read the recipe before the first call of that flow in a conversation. It is a guide, never the user's go: every paid call in it still needs its own price and ask.
name: get_recipe
title: Get a step-by-step recipe
